scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.dev:api: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync uvicorn teacher_workspace.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.worker
scripts.lint:backend: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync ruff check apps/backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:backend && pnpm typecheck:api-client
scripts.typecheck:backend: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync mypy apps/backend/src
scripts.test:backend: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync pytest apps/backend/tests
scripts.db:migrate: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:rollback: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini downgrade -1
scripts.api:generate: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript packages/api-client/openapi.json -o packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts
scripts.docx:sample: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python scripts/generate_sample_docx.py
scripts.backup:create: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.backup_restore create
scripts.backup:verify: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.backup_restore verify
scripts.backup:drill: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.backup_restore drill
scripts.backup:restore: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.backup_restore restore
scripts.production:check: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.production_check
scripts.security:static: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.security_check
scripts.security:dependencies: pnpm audit --audit-level high && cross-env PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync pip-audit
scripts.performance:smoke: cross-env PYTHONPATH=apps/backend/src uv run --project apps/backend --no-sync python -m teacher_workspace.performance_smoke
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm api:generate && pnpm build && pnpm security:static
scripts.check:release: pnpm check && pnpm security:dependencies && docker compose config --quiet && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml config --quiet && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.validation.yaml config --quiet
